title: Coupons
subtitle: 「優惠券／折扣券／代用券」，先分清是減價、兌換、儲值，還是輸入數碼代碼。
description: 「優惠券／折扣券／代用券」，先分清是減價、兌換、儲值，還是輸入數碼代碼。

words.example: Customers can redeem the voucher at any branch.
words.exampleZh: 顧客可以在任何分店兌換這張代用券。

exercises.original: Customers can use the coupons at any branch.
exercises.zh: 顧客可以在任何分店使用這些代用券。
exercises.upgrade: Customers can redeem the vouchers at any branch.

options.explanation: redeem + any branch 是標準代用券／優惠券用法。
收據是購買後證明，不能拿來兌換折扣。
票通常用於入場／乘車，不等於一般零售優惠。
會員卡證明身份，不是一張次次兌換的 coupon。
回贈通常是購買後申請退回金額。
offer 是優惠條件，不是持有人拿去兌換的憑證。

exercises.original: The hotel gave guests coupons for a free breakfast.
exercises.zh: 酒店給住客免費早餐代用券。
exercises.upgrade: The hotel gave guests vouchers for a free breakfast.

options.explanation: free breakfast 是可兌換的服務權利，voucher 很自然。
某些地方可稱 breakfast ticket，但一般 coupon/voucher 更自然。
酒店是發出具體可兌換憑證，不只是宣布優惠。

exercises.original: The charity distributed food coupons to families.
exercises.zh: 慈善機構向家庭派發食品代用券。
exercises.upgrade: The charity distributed food vouchers to families.

options.explanation: food vouchers 是援助／福利語境中常見固定搭配。
一般 food assistance 不是入場票。
太抽象，沒有具體兌換工具。

words.example: The leaflet includes discount tickets for local attractions.
words.exampleZh: 傳單附有本地景點的折扣券。

exercises.original: The leaflet includes coupons for reduced entry to local attractions.
exercises.zh: 傳單附有本地景點的折扣票券。
exercises.upgrade: The leaflet includes discount tickets for local attractions.

options.explanation: reduced entry + attractions 表示持券可減價入場。
是預付價值，不是這種入場折扣。
不一定一次性附在傳單中。

exercises.original: Visitors received coupons giving twenty per cent off admission.
exercises.zh: 訪客收到可減免百分之二十入場費的折扣票券。
exercises.upgrade: Visitors received discount tickets giving twenty per cent off admission.

options.explanation: twenty per cent off admission 是明確折扣用途。
不一定與 admission 折扣相關。
不一定是單次折扣憑證。

exercises.original: The tourist booklet contained coupons for museum entry.
exercises.zh: 旅遊小冊子附有博物館入場折扣券。
exercises.upgrade: The tourist booklet contained discount tickets for museum entry.

options.explanation: booklet + museum entry + coupon function 可自然理解為折扣票券。
小冊子通常不會包含會員卡。
coupon 的核心優惠性消失。

words.meaning: 減價代幣；扣減金額優惠券
words.example: The magazine contained several money-off tokens for groceries.
words.exampleZh: 雜誌附有數張雜貨減價優惠券。

exercises.original: The magazine contained coupons worth one pound off selected products.
exercises.zh: 雜誌附有每張可減一鎊的優惠券。
exercises.upgrade: The magazine contained money-off tokens worth one pound off selected products.

options.explanation: worth one pound off 是固定金額減價的直接線索。
不表示一次固定減一鎊。
通常購買後才退回金額。
儲存價值，不是折扣工具。

exercises.original: Shoppers clipped coupons from the newspaper to save fifty pence.
exercises.zh: 顧客從報紙剪下減五十便士優惠券。
exercises.upgrade: Shoppers clipped money-off tokens from the newspaper to save fifty pence.

options.explanation: clipped from newspaper + fixed amount 是傳統英式 money-off token/coupon 語境。
不需要剪券在結帳時使用。

exercises.original: The cereal box offered a coupon for fifty cents off the next purchase.
exercises.zh: 穀物盒提供下次購買可減五角的優惠券。
exercises.upgrade: The cereal box offered a money-off token for fifty cents off the next purchase.

options.explanation: fixed fifty cents off 是最典型 money-off 功能。
不會提供下一次優惠權。
rebate 多在購買後申請，和結帳直接扣減不同。

words.example: Shoppers can download discount coupons from the website.
words.exampleZh: 顧客可以從網站下載折扣券。

exercises.original: Shoppers can download coupons from the website to reduce the price.
exercises.zh: 顧客可從網站下載折扣券以減低價格。
exercises.upgrade: Shoppers can download discount coupons from the website.

options.explanation: download + reduce the price 是標準折扣券。
不是這種一次性下載券。

exercises.original: The restaurant emailed coupons offering fifteen per cent off.
exercises.zh: 餐廳電郵發送可享八五折的折扣券。
exercises.upgrade: The restaurant emailed discount coupons offering fifteen per cent off.

options.explanation: fifteen per cent off 是折扣券直接功能。
不一定透過電郵一次性發出。

exercises.original: The app stores digital coupons for participating shops.
exercises.zh: 應用程式儲存參與商店的數碼折扣券。
exercises.upgrade: The app stores digital discount coupons for participating shops.

options.explanation: digital + participating shops 是現代 retail coupon 語境。
會把所有優惠誤解為預付價值。

words.meaning: 促銷優惠券；推廣代用券
words.example: The company sent promotional vouchers to loyalty members.
words.exampleZh: 公司向會員發送促銷優惠券。

exercises.original: The company sent coupons to loyalty members as part of a promotion.
exercises.zh: 公司在促銷活動中向會員發送優惠券。
exercises.upgrade: The company sent promotional vouchers to loyalty members.

options.explanation: as part of a promotion + loyalty members 明確是促銷券。
loyalty members 已經有會員身份，發送的是另一項優惠。

exercises.original: Guests received coupons encouraging them to return next month.
exercises.zh: 住客收到鼓勵下月再次光顧的促銷券。
exercises.upgrade: Guests received promotional vouchers encouraging them to return next month.

options.explanation: encouraging return visits 是典型促銷目的。
不會主動提供未來促銷權。
可能不是預付價值，只是優惠。

exercises.original: The retailer printed coupons for its seasonal campaign.
exercises.zh: 零售商為季度推廣印製促銷優惠券。
exercises.upgrade: The retailer printed promotional vouchers for its seasonal campaign.

options.explanation: 不是季度一次性促銷券。

words.example: Enter the discount code at checkout to save ten per cent.
words.exampleZh: 結帳時輸入折扣碼可節省百分之十。

exercises.original: Enter the coupon at online checkout to save ten per cent.
exercises.zh: 網上結帳時輸入優惠碼可節省百分之十。
exercises.upgrade: Enter the discount code at online checkout to save ten per cent.

options.explanation: enter at online checkout 是數碼折扣碼的直接線索。
收據號碼通常在付款後產生。
可識別會員，但不是這次優惠本身。
不是輸入代碼即時減價。

exercises.original: The website asks shoppers to type a coupon before payment.
exercises.zh: 網站要求顧客付款前輸入折扣碼。
exercises.upgrade: The website asks shoppers to type a discount code before payment.

options.explanation: type + before payment 是純數碼 code 使用方式。
付款前通常還沒有收據。
不一定輸入一次性折扣碼。

exercises.original: Subscribers received a coupon code by email.
exercises.zh: 訂閱者透過電郵收到折扣碼。
exercises.upgrade: Subscribers received a discount code by email.

options.explanation: by email + code 是最自然的數碼優惠。
可能也有 code，但原句只說優惠折扣。

words.example: The influencer shared a promo code with followers.
words.exampleZh: 網紅向追隨者分享了一個促銷碼。

exercises.original: The influencer shared a coupon with followers for free delivery.
exercises.zh: 網紅向追隨者分享免運費促銷碼。
exercises.upgrade: The influencer shared a promo code with followers for free delivery.

options.explanation: influencer + followers + free delivery 是現代 promo code 的典型場景。

exercises.original: Use the coupon advertised on social media to get twenty per cent off.
exercises.zh: 使用社交媒體宣傳的促銷碼可享八折。
exercises.upgrade: Use the promo code advertised on social media to get twenty per cent off.

options.explanation: social media + percentage discount 是典型促銷碼。
收據上的代碼不一定給優惠。

exercises.original: The app displays a coupon for new customers at sign-up.
exercises.zh: 應用程式在新客戶登記時顯示促銷碼。
exercises.upgrade: The app displays a promo code for new customers at sign-up.

options.explanation: sign-up promotion 是數碼促銷碼常見用途。
sign-up 身份和促銷碼不同。

words.meaning: 現金折扣券；減價代用券
words.example: Members receive a five-pound money-off voucher each month.
words.exampleZh: 會員每月會收到一張五鎊現金折扣券。

exercises.original: Members receive a coupon worth five pounds off each month.
exercises.zh: 會員每月收到一張可減五鎊的優惠券。
exercises.upgrade: Members receive a five-pound money-off voucher each month.

options.explanation: five-pound off 是固定金額折扣，英式 retail 搭配自然。
會員身份本身不是每月一次優惠。
gift card 儲值和 money-off discount 不同。

exercises.original: The supermarket sent households coupons worth three pounds off groceries.
exercises.zh: 超市向家庭寄發可減三鎊雜貨費的現金折扣券。
exercises.upgrade: The supermarket sent households three-pound money-off vouchers for groceries.

options.explanation: supermarket + fixed £3 off groceries 是典型英式用法。
通常代表可花費的預付價值。

exercises.original: A coupon gives customers ten dollars off orders over fifty dollars.
exercises.zh: 這張優惠券可令滿五十元訂單減十元。
exercises.upgrade: A money-off voucher gives customers ten dollars off orders over fifty dollars.

options.explanation: ten dollars off 是固定金額減免。
不一定是預付現金值，而是有條件折扣。

words.meaning: 可兌換代用券；可換領券
words.example: Each participant receives a voucher redeemable for one free meal.
words.exampleZh: 每名參加者都會收到一張可兌換免費餐的代用券。

exercises.original: Each participant receives a coupon for one free meal.
exercises.zh: 每名參加者都獲一張可兌換免費餐的代用券。
exercises.upgrade: Each participant receives a voucher redeemable for one free meal.

options.explanation: for one free meal 是明確兌換權。
meal voucher 可以像 ticket，但 redeemable voucher 更準確表達兌換功能。
只是優惠條件，不是持有的憑證。

exercises.original: The coupon can be exchanged for a cinema ticket.
exercises.zh: 這張券可以兌換電影票。
exercises.upgrade: The redeemable voucher can be exchanged for a cinema ticket.

options.explanation: can be exchanged for 是 redeemable 的直接定義。
不能用來換電影票，除非另有活動規則。
未必有金額餘額，只是特定兌換權。

exercises.original: Guests were given coupons valid for one spa treatment.
exercises.zh: 住客獲發可換一次水療服務的代用券。
exercises.upgrade: Guests were given redeemable vouchers valid for one spa treatment.

options.explanation: valid for one treatment 是服務兌換權。
某些服務可用 ticket，但 voucher 更自然。
原句是實際發給住客的憑證。

words.example: The store coupons are valid only at participating branches.
words.exampleZh: 這些商店優惠券只可在參與活動的分店使用。

exercises.original: These coupons are valid only at participating branches of the same retailer.
exercises.zh: 這些優惠券只可在同一零售商參與活動的分店使用。
exercises.upgrade: These store coupons are valid only at participating branches.

options.explanation: only at branches of same retailer 是店舖專用券的核心。
製造商券可能在多間零售商使用，範圍不同。
商店券可以是折扣券，不一定有儲值。

exercises.original: The supermarket issues coupons that can only be used in its own stores.
exercises.zh: 超市發出只可在自家店舖使用的優惠券。
exercises.upgrade: The supermarket issues store coupons that can only be used in its own stores.

options.explanation: issued by supermarket + own stores 是直接定義。
身份工具，不等於具體一次優惠。
會跨零售商，和 own stores 相反。

exercises.original: A store coupon cannot be redeemed at a competing chain.
exercises.zh: 商店優惠券不能在競爭連鎖店使用。
exercises.upgrade: A store coupon cannot be redeemed at a competing chain.

options.explanation: 也通常有發行商限制，但這裡是 coupon 而非預付卡。

words.example: She received a restaurant gift voucher for her birthday.
words.exampleZh: 她生日收到一張餐廳禮券。

exercises.original: She received a restaurant coupon worth fifty dollars for her birthday.
exercises.zh: 她生日收到一張價值五十元的餐廳禮券。
exercises.upgrade: She received a fifty-dollar restaurant gift voucher for her birthday.

options.explanation: birthday + fixed stored value 是典型禮券。
通常只是減價，不代表整整五十元預付價值。

exercises.original: The company gave staff coupons to spend at a department store.
exercises.zh: 公司向員工發放可在百貨公司消費的禮券。
exercises.upgrade: The company gave staff gift vouchers to spend at a department store.

options.explanation: to spend at a department store 表示預付／禮物價值。
只減價，不一定可直接抵消價值。

exercises.original: A coupon with a stored value can be used as a present.
exercises.zh: 有儲值金額的券可以作禮物。
exercises.upgrade: A gift voucher with stored value can be used as a present.

options.explanation: stored value + present 是直接線索。
discount coupon 不一定有任何儲值。

words.example: Staff received meal vouchers during the conference.
words.exampleZh: 員工在會議期間獲發餐券。

exercises.original: Staff received coupons for lunch during the conference.
exercises.zh: 員工在會議期間獲發餐券。
exercises.upgrade: Staff received meal vouchers during the conference.

options.explanation: lunch during conference 是典型餐券用途。
某些活動可用 meal tickets，但 voucher 更廣且自然。
不一定有可自由花費的儲值。

exercises.original: The airline issued coupons for dinner after the delay.
exercises.zh: 航班延誤後，航空公司發出晚餐券。
exercises.upgrade: The airline issued meal vouchers after the delay.

options.explanation: airline delay + dinner compensation 是典型 meal voucher。
是登機證，不提供晚餐本身。
航空公司是發出可實際換餐的憑證。

exercises.original: Students were given coupons that could be exchanged for a school lunch.
exercises.zh: 學生獲發可兌換學校午餐的餐券。
exercises.upgrade: Students were given meal vouchers that could be exchanged for a school lunch.

options.explanation: exchanged for school lunch 是直接定義。
可在某些制度使用，但 meal voucher 更準確。
範圍太廣，且未必只限膳食。

words.example: Paste the coupon code into the box before payment.
words.exampleZh: 付款前把優惠碼貼到欄位中。

exercises.original: Paste the coupon into the box before payment.
exercises.zh: 付款前把優惠券代碼貼到欄位中。
exercises.upgrade: Paste the coupon code into the box before payment.

options.explanation: paste into the box 是明確網上代碼形式。
身份識別碼不一定提供這項優惠。
是金額，不是要貼上的 code。

exercises.original: The checkout page has a field for coupons.
exercises.zh: 結帳頁面有一個優惠碼欄位。
exercises.upgrade: The checkout page has a field for coupon codes.

options.explanation: field for... 是輸入數碼代碼的標準界面。
實體卡不是文字欄位內容，雖然可能另有 gift-card code。

exercises.original: Each customer received a unique digital coupon to enter online.
exercises.zh: 每名顧客收到一個可在網上輸入的獨特優惠碼。
exercises.upgrade: Each customer received a unique coupon code to enter online.

options.explanation: unique + enter online 表示代碼式 coupon。
和 enter online 的形式不一致。

falseSynonyms.zh: 收據不等於 coupon receipt 是付款後的購買證明；coupon 是付款前或付款時用來獲取優惠／兌換權。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A receipt records a purchase; a coupon changes the purchase terms.

falseSynonyms.zh: 票不等於所有 coupon ticket 通常賦予入場或乘搭權；coupon 通常提供折扣或兌換優惠。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A ticket grants access or travel; a coupon usually grants a discount or offer.

falseSynonyms.zh: 禮品卡不等於一般 coupon gift card 通常有預付餘額；coupon 多數是折扣或特定優惠。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A gift card stores value; a coupon usually reduces price or grants an offer.

falseSynonyms.zh: 會員卡不等於 coupon 會員卡證明會員身份；優惠可能透過會員卡獲得，但卡本身不是 coupon。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A membership card identifies eligibility; a coupon is a specific offer.

falseSynonyms.zh: 回贈不等於 coupon rebate 通常在購買後退回部分金額；coupon 通常在購買時直接減價。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A rebate is often claimed after purchase; a coupon is usually applied at purchase.

falseSynonyms.zh: 優惠不等於 coupon offer 是促銷條件本身；coupon 是獲取／兌現優惠的一種工具。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An offer is the deal; a coupon is one mechanism for receiving it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 代幣不等於所有 coupon token 可以是實體／數碼憑證、遊戲代幣或象徵物；只有在 money-off / redeemable 語境才接近 coupon。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Token is broader; only some tokens function as coupons.

falseSynonyms.zh: voucher 和 coupon 很接近，但範圍不同 voucher 可代表預付價值、禮券、服務兌換；coupon 常更偏促銷折扣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Vouchers can carry value or entitlement; coupons often provide discounts.
